text_block_list.text:
Super Creek mentioned she was going to 
practice dancing on her own, so I decided 
to observe, but—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a wonderful dance~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still... fufu. The way Trainer-san is 
gazing at me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes were sparkling so brightly, she 
looked just like a little child.
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's because Creek looked like she 
was having so much fun dancing?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Don't tell me you felt like 
dancing too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's lovely. Shall we try dancing 
together next~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. There's still plenty of 
time before the next appointment... right?
choice_data_list:
I'd just get in the way of your extra 
practice, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. There's still plenty of 
time before the next appointment... right?
choice_data_list:
I'd just get in the way of your extra 
practice, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, to think I'd get to dance with you, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe my eyes will be the ones sparkling 
like crazy this time~♪"

I stood on stage with Super Creek. She 
danced happily, keeping a warm smile on 
her face the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've been dancing all alone today, 
and it feels a little lonely...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if there's a kind Trainer who 
would dance with me?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Thank goodness, you were right 
hereâª

Led by the hand by Super Creek, I enjoyed 
dancing with her. Watching my movements, 
she seemed to have learned something.
